Video of the engine running or being hand-cranked to prove it is not seized.
Close-up photo inside the oil filler neck.
response.reason: The specific engine model code (e.g., G4FC, G4KD, G4LA) is not visible. These engines look similar but have significantly different market values and are not interchangeable.
